# Binary closed context

Owned factories retain two method-scoped Object formals in complete invariant
input/output carriers. A separate invariant binary mapper has closed exception
arguments and contributes no method formal. Source and SDK-provider modes retain
opaque outputs, callback identities, nulls, partial writes and exact exceptions.
Four frozen routes cover either input order. Six wrong programs and six
Code-preserving Signature controls guard behavior, scopes and physical erasures.
